literal: In action, action he who possesses - friendship different to become - him who considers, will depart prosperity.
translation: Prosperity will abandon the leader who thinks of altering his friendship with a man capable of executing the work.
modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்து முடிக்கும் திறமை உடையவனின் நட்பை வேறுவிதமாக (சந்தேகத்துடன்) நினைப்பவனை விட்டுச் செல்வம் நீங்கிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against mistrusting a capable worker once a task has been entrusted to them. The phrase 'வினைக்கண் வினையுடையான்' refers to a person who possesses the practical ability to accomplish a given task. 'கேண்மை வேறாக நினைப்பானை' describes a leader who alters his friendly relationship with such a worker, often out of unwarranted suspicion. If a leader alienates their most competent people through mistrust, 'திரு' or prosperity will naturally leave them, as success depends on capable execution.
